cmapss.local_path: data/raw/cmapss/6.+Turbofan+Engine+Degradation+Simulation+Data+Set/6. Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set/CMAPSSData
cmapss.dataset_purpose: RUL methodology benchmarking. Simulated turbofan engine run-to-failure data.
cmapss.sampling_frequency: 1 sample per operational flight cycle (not time-based)
cmapss.labels_and_targets: RUL ground truth provided for test sets (RUL_FD001-FD004.txt). Training data runs to failure.
cmapss.operating_conditions: FD001/FD003: single (sea level). FD002/FD004: six operating conditions.
cmapss.corrupted_or_incomplete_files: None. Additional large ZIP (17. Turbofan+Engine+Degradation+Simulation+Data+Set+2.zip, 14.7 GB) present but is N-CMAPSS, treated as out-of-scope.
cmapss.data_leakage_risks: Low if split by unit_number. Standard convention is train/test per subset.
cmapss.suitable_project_use: RUL degradation methodology, sequence model benchmarking, prognostic algorithm comparison
cmapss.unsuitable_project_use: Direct aero-piston telemetry. C-MAPSS sensors are turbofan variables and must NOT be mapped to CHT, EGT, oil_temp, oil_pressure, or fuel_flow.
cmapss.required_preprocessing: Parse space-delimited text. Generate RUL labels. Remove constant sensors for FD001/FD003. Use cmapss_s_N naming.
cmapss.final_recommendation: Use for RUL methodology validation only. Existing unsafe mappings in telemetry/adapters.py (s_2->cht, s_3->egt, etc.) must be quarantined.

cwru.dataset_purpose: Rotational bearing fault harmonic orders and vibration signatures
cwru.sampling_frequency: 12 kHz (standard). Some files at 48 kHz (not present).
cwru.labels_and_targets: Fault type and severity encoded in file naming convention. 97.mat=normal, 105.mat=inner race 7mil, 130.mat=outer race 7mil.
cwru.operating_conditions: Motor load and RPM. Available files are at 0 HP load, 1797 RPM.
cwru.corrupted_or_incomplete_files: None. However, only 3 out of ~160+ files in the full CWRU collection are present (core profile only).
cwru.data_leakage_risks: Low â€” split by source file (each file = different bearing condition).
cwru.suitable_project_use: Vibration feature extraction methodology, bearing fault signature analysis, crest factor/kurtosis benchmarking
cwru.unsuitable_project_use: Direct aero-piston telemetry substitution. This is an electric motor test rig.
cwru.required_preprocessing: Load via scipy.io.loadmat. Extract windowed features (RMS, std, peak, kurtosis, etc.). Preserve bearing/file provenance.
cwru.final_recommendation: Use for vibration feature methodology. Only 3 files available â€” sufficient for algorithm validation but not comprehensive training.
cwru.limitations_of_available_subset: The available raw CWRU subset contains 3 files representing distinct fault conditions (97.mat=normal, 105.mat=inner race 7mil, 130.mat=outer race 7mil). Because each fault class exists in only one file, train/test splitting across files would cause zero-shot evaluation or class omission. Therefore, a single unified, validated feature table is published for baseline methodology verification.

femto.dataset_purpose: Accelerated run-to-failure degradation trajectories for bearing health monitoring
femto.sampling_frequency: 25.6 kHz per acquisition, sampled every 10 seconds (0.1s snapshot = 2560 samples per file)
femto.labels_and_targets: Training bearings are run-to-failure (RUL derivable). Test bearings are truncated (RUL unknown without external reference).
femto.operating_conditions: Condition 1: 1800 rpm / 4000 N. Condition 2: 1650 rpm / 4200 N. Condition 3: 1500 rpm / 5000 N.
femto.missing_values: Rare. Some files may have slightly different sample counts.
femto.corrupted_or_incomplete_files: Two additional ZIP archives present (Training_set.zip=134 MB, Validation_Set.zip=317 MB) â€” likely redundant with extracted directories.
femto.duplicate_files: ZIP archives may duplicate extracted data
femto.data_leakage_risks: HIGH if windows from the same bearing are split across train/test. Must split by bearing ID.
femto.suitable_project_use: Degradation trajectory analysis, RUL methodology, health index monotonicity, vibration feature trending
femto.unsuitable_project_use: Direct aero-piston engine RUL. These are component-level bearing experiments.
femto.required_preprocessing: Load CSVs in file-sequence order. Build per-bearing degradation trajectories. Extract windowed features. Generate RUL from run-to-failure count. Split by bearing ID.
femto.final_recommendation: Excellent for degradation methodology validation. 6 training + 11 test bearings fully available.

nasa_battery.dataset_purpose: Electrochemical capacity degradation and SOH methodology under temperature cycles
nasa_battery.labels_and_targets: Capacity fade over cycles. End-of-life defined by capacity threshold.
nasa_battery.operating_conditions: Controlled environmental chamber cycling at various temperatures
nasa_battery.missing_values: None in valid measurement columns; non-discharge cycles have NaN for capacity/SOH by physical design.
nasa_battery.duplicate_files: Redundant B0025-B0028 in archive 2 and 3 deduplicated.
nasa_battery.data_leakage_risks: Low â€” split by battery ID (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018).
nasa_battery.suitable_project_use: SOH degradation methodology, capacity fade modeling, health index validation
nasa_battery.unsuitable_project_use: Direct engine telemetry. Battery voltage/current/capacity are electrochemical, NOT engine variables.
nasa_battery.required_preprocessing: Extract ZIP archives. Load .mat files. Build cycle-level degradation records. Preserve battery ID.
nasa_battery.final_recommendation: Use for degradation methodology only. Requires ZIP extraction before processing.

nust.dataset_name: NUST IC-Engine Journal Bearing Vibration Dataset
nust.dataset_purpose: Reciprocating IC-engine vibration behavior and journal bearing fault signatures under climatic variations
nust.sampling_frequency: Variable (timestamps in CSV range from ~0.0008 to ~0.00148s per sample)
nust.labels_and_targets: Healthy vs. Faulty encoded in directory structure. RPM (1000/1500/2000), Humidity (0/50/100%), Temperature (-10 to 55Â°C).
nust.missing_values: Some files have duplicate first rows. Rear Input 1-8 are consistently zero.
nust.corrupted_or_incomplete_files: 201 DOCX and 346 RTF files are supplementary (not machine-readable CSV). Only 134 CSV files are processed.
nust.duplicate_files: Two dataset variants: 'Engine Journal Bearings Dataset' and 'Engine Journal Bearings Dataset 2'. May contain overlapping experiments.
nust.data_leakage_risks: Medium â€” must split by experimental condition, not by random rows from the same run.
nust.suitable_project_use: Highest relevance: reciprocating IC-engine vibration under thermal/humidity stress. Journal bearing fault detection.
nust.unsuitable_project_use: This is an automotive/industrial engine test bench, not an aero-piston flight unit. Do not fabricate CHT, EGT, oil_pressure channels.
nust.required_preprocessing: Parse CSVs. Extract metadata from path. Detect quality issues. Preserve original 20-column structure. Classify operating regions.
nust.final_recommendation: Best physical relevance among all datasets (reciprocating IC-engine). Use for vibration methodology with clear disclaimers about automotive vs. aviation context.

paderborn.dataset_purpose: Mechanical bearing fault signatures, vibration distributions, and damage-type evidence
paderborn.labels_and_targets: Bearing condition encoded in filename prefix: K0xx=healthy, KAxx=outer race fault, KBxx=combined, KIxx=inner race fault.
paderborn.operating_conditions: Controlled test rig with variable speed and load
paderborn.missing_values: 0 missing values across all 29,792 window feature vectors.
paderborn.corrupted_or_incomplete_files: 0 corrupt files among processed MAT files.
paderborn.data_leakage_risks: Medium â€” must split by bearing ID, not by random windows.
paderborn.suitable_project_use: Bearing fault classification, vibration feature benchmarking, damage-type taxonomy
paderborn.unsuitable_project_use: Direct engine telemetry. Electric motor test bench, not engine block.
paderborn.required_preprocessing: Extract RAR archives (selectively). Load .mat files via scipy. Extract windowed vibration features. Preserve bearing metadata.
paderborn.final_recommendation: Excellent for vibration feature methodology. 32 bearings across healthy/artificial/real damage conditions. Requires RAR extraction tool.
